name: Compute Exchange
description: Compute marketplace starbridge-app: a factory-born job cell composing BUDGET (bid <= budget, the AffineLe budget gate) + ACCEPTED (write-once accepted bid) + FLASHWELL (the settlement RECORD neither mints nor burns, paid + refunded == budget) + LIFECYCLE (one-way POSTED -> BID -> SETTLED), re-enforced by the verified executor every turn. A requester posts a job with a PROMISED budget (the job cell cannot escrow it); a provider bids a price that must fit the budget; settlement PAYS the provider a real conserving Effect::Transfer in the same turn as it records the split, so a requester who cannot cover the accepted bid takes the SETTLED stamp down with the payment.
state_constraints: AffineLe(PAID + REFUNDED - BUDGET <= 0)   [three FIELD SLOTS; the VALUE leg is the settle Effect::Transfer]

deos.mount: register_deos (src/lib.rs) — folds the composed DeosApp into the StarbridgeAppContext affordance registry and SEEDS the job cell (installs the job program, POSTED state); DeosApp::mount yields the axum router
deos.publish: Signature (the job cell is a dregg:// sturdyref a provider/auditor on another federation reacquires)

affordances.view_job: cap-only, Signature (an OBSERVER reads the job state)
affordances.bid: GATED (cap∧state), Either — posted precondition (STATE == POSTED); the fire submits the FULL bid (provider + bid + state->BID), the executor re-enforcing BUDGET FieldLteField(BID <= BUDGET)
affordances.settle: GATED (cap∧state), None/root — bid precondition (STATE == BID); the fire reads live BID + BUDGET, TRANSFERS the accepted bid to the provider and records the split (paid := bid, refunded := budget - bid, state->SETTLED) in ONE action, the executor re-enforcing FLASHWELL AffineEq(PAID + REFUNDED == BUDGET) on the record and InsufficientBalance on the payment

deos.rights_ladder: Signature ⊂ Either ⊂ None IS the observer ⊂ provider ⊂ requester ladder
deos.seam: CLOSED — the fire runs against the seeded job cell carrying the full job program (BUDGET + ACCEPTED + FLASHWELL + LIFECYCLE), so an OVER-BUDGET bid (FieldLteField), a VALUE-CONJURING settle (AffineEq/AffineLe), a NON-ADVANCING state (StrictMonotonic, strict) and an UNFUNDABLE settlement (InsufficientBalance on the settle Transfer) all BITE in the deos fire path (tests/deos_seam.rs — the headline teeth). The factory-born cell carries the flat state_constraints predicate, so the budget and conservation teeth are executor refusals on the born cell too (tests/factory_birth.rs), and tests/settlement_conservation.rs asserts the BALANCES on both poles.
